releases.name: v0.3.17 — Changes tab shows releases only
releases.summary: Changes tab shows GitHub releases (tag + notes) instead of merge-commit spam · Pending update lists newer release tags when the host is behind
releases.body:
- Changes tab shows GitHub releases (tag + notes) instead of merge-commit spam
- Pending update lists newer release tags when the host is behind

releases.name: v0.3.16 — Stop majors P2 churn on PUMP fee dips
releases.summary: Majors P2 requires both fee and volume dead (no more rotate-on-fee-dip-alone) · Lower rotation fee floor + ~30 min sustained polls to stop PUMP open/close rent burn
releases.body:
- Majors P2 requires both fee and volume dead (no more rotate-on-fee-dip-alone)
- Lower rotation fee floor + ~30 min sustained polls to stop PUMP open/close rent burn

releases.name: v0.3.15 — Fix dash crash on GitHub API 403
releases.summary: Dashboard no longer crashes when GitHub rate-limits the Changes history fetch (403) · Changes may be empty briefly under rate-limit; set optional GITHUB_TOKEN on Railway for a higher quota
releases.body:
- Dashboard no longer crashes when GitHub rate-limits the Changes history fetch (403)
- Changes may be empty briefly under rate-limit; set optional GITHUB_TOKEN on Railway for a higher quota

releases.name: v0.3.14 — Reload toast when dashboard UI is stale after deploy
releases.summary: Sticky toast with Reload when your open dashboard tab is still on the old UI after a SPA deploy · Bot-only deploys do not prompt · index.html served no-store so Reload picks up the new shell
releases.body:
- Sticky toast with Reload when your open dashboard tab is still on the old UI after a SPA deploy
- Bot-only deploys do not prompt
- index.html served no-store so Reload picks up the new shell

releases.name: v0.3.13 — Changes tab shows releases and what landed
releases.summary: Changes tab: Releases panel (tag + summary) so operators see what shipped at a glance · Commit list rewrites merge / bare Release subjects using GitHub release notes · RELEASE.md + agent rule: release commits and PRs must include an operator one-liner
releases.body:
- Changes tab: Releases panel (tag + summary) so operators see what shipped at a glance
- Commit list rewrites merge / bare Release subjects using GitHub release notes
- RELEASE.md + agent rule: release commits and PRs must include an operator one-liner

releases.name: DLMM Bot v0.3.12
releases.summary: Railway redeploys exit cleanly on SIGTERM so auto-updates no longer trigger false Deploy Crashed emails. Optional: set `RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS=5` on the service.
releases.body: Railway redeploys exit cleanly on SIGTERM so auto-updates no longer trigger false Deploy Crashed emails. Optional: set `RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS=5` on the service.
